title: Types of Microscopes
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about simple and compound microscopes — how they work and how they help us see a tiny world.

questions.prompt: What does a microscope help us do?
choices: See very small things more clearly
questions.explanation: A microscope helps us see very small things more clearly.

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between a simple microscope and a compound microscope?
choices: A simple microscope uses one lens, while a compound microscope uses more than one lens
A simple microscope uses light, while a compound microscope does not
A simple microscope is only used for cells, while a compound microscope is only used for plants
A simple microscope has more lenses than a compound microscope
questions.explanation: A simple microscope uses one lens, while a compound microscope uses more than one lens.

questions.prompt: Which microscope part keeps the slide in place?
questions.explanation: Stage clips keep the slide in place.

questions.prompt: If the eyepiece magnification is 10× and the objective magnification is 4×, what is the total magnification?
Which part of a compound microscope is used to make small changes to sharpen the image?
questions.explanation: The fine adjustment knob is used to make small changes to sharpen the image.
